faq1Q: What types of furniture do you offer?
faq1A: We specialize in custom-finish modular furniture. Our range includes living room furniture, dining sets, bedroom furniture, office furniture, and storage solutions. All pieces are designed to fit your unique space and style preferences.
faq2Q: Can I customize the furniture design?
faq2A: Absolutely! We pride ourselves on offering fully customizable options. You can choose from a variety of finishes, materials, colors, and configurations to ensure your furniture matches your style and needs perfectly.
faq3Q: How do I place an order?
faq3A: You can place an order by contacting us directly through our website or by visiting our showroom. We’ll work with you to understand your requirements, help you select the right design, and provide a quote. Once you're happy with the details, we’ll proceed with manufacturing your custom piece.
faq4A: We offer a wide selection of high-quality materials, including solid wood, engineered wood, MDF, laminate, and metal accents. All materials are carefully sourced for durability and aesthetic appeal.
faq5Q: How long will it take to receive my furniture?
faq5A: Lead times for custom furniture can vary depending on the complexity of the design and order volume. Typically, delivery takes between 4-14 days after final approval of your design. We’ll keep you updated throughout the process.
faq6Q: Do you offer delivery and installation services?
faq6A: Yes, we offer delivery and professional installation services. Our team ensures that your furniture is carefully transported and properly set up in your home or office, so you can start enjoying it right away.
faq7Q: What if I need to make changes to my order after it's placed?
faq7A: Once we’ve finalized your design and production has started, changes may be limited. However, if you're in the early stages of the process, we’re happy to accommodate revisions. Please reach out to us as soon as possible to discuss any modifications.
faq8Q: Can I see a sample of the materials and finishes?
faq8A: Yes! We offer samples of our materials and finishes upon request. You can also visit our showroom to see and feel the materials in person before making your decision.
faq9Q: Do you offer warranties on your furniture?
faq9A: Yes, all of our furniture comes with a warranty. The exact duration of the warranty depends on the type of product and materials used. Please contact us for specific warranty details.
faq10Q: How do I care for my furniture?
faq10A: We provide detailed care instructions for each type of material used in our furniture. Regular dusting, cleaning with gentle products, and avoiding harsh chemicals will help maintain the beauty and durability of your pieces.
faq11Q: Do you offer any discounts or promotions?
faq11A: We occasionally offer special promotions or discounts on select items. Be sure to sign up for our newsletter or follow us on social media to stay informed about current offers.
faq12Q: Can you help me with designing a layout for my space?
faq12A: Yes, we offer design consultations to help you create the perfect furniture layout for your space.
faq13Q: Do you have a showroom I can visit?
faq13A: Yes, we have a showroom where you can explore our range of furniture designs and materials.
faq14Q: How can I contact you for further questions or support?
faq14A: For any additional questions, please contact us through the website’s contact form, phone, or email.
faq15Q: Do you provide furniture for commercial spaces?
faq15A: Yes, we provide custom modular furniture for commercial spaces including offices, retail stores, and restaurants.
faq16Q: What if I’m not happy with my custom furniture once it arrives?
faq16A: If there is any manufacturing defect or issue, we’ll resolve it immediately. Since custom pieces are made to order, returns can be limited.
faq17Q: Do you offer financing or payment plans?
faq17A: Yes, we offer flexible financing options. Please contact us for details.
faq18Q: What makes your furniture different from other manufacturers?
faq18A: Our custom modular furniture stands out due to premium materials, personalization, and long-lasting durability.
faq19Q: Can I visit your factory or see how the furniture is made?
faq19A: Yes! We can arrange a factory tour. Contact us to schedule a visit.
faq20Q: What if I have a specific design idea that’s not on your website?
faq20A: You can share your custom design idea with us, and we will help turn it into reality.
faq21Q: Do you offer furniture for small or unique spaces?
faq21A: Yes, our modular designs are ideal for small or uniquely shaped spaces.

aboutP1: Furnkaar is the Signature Collection by Shilpkaar Furnitures — a premium line that brings together artistic craftsmanship, advanced technology, and elegant design to create furniture that stands apart.
aboutP2: At Shilpkaar Furnitures, we’ve built a legacy of precision engineering and fine detailing. Furnkaar carries this heritage forward — offering refined, factory-finished furniture that blends beauty, comfort, and durability. Each piece is thoughtfully designed to represent a perfect balance of art and functionality.
aboutP3: Based in Indore, our in-house facility is powered by modern CNC and German edge-banding technology. From modular kitchens and wardrobes to statement pieces and luxury interiors, Furnkaar by Shilpkaar ensures every product is crafted with unmatched precision and timeless aesthetics.
value1Desc: Every creation is built using CNC and edge-banding machines for millimeter-perfect accuracy and a flawless factory finish.
value2Desc: We believe every space has its own identity. Our designs are customized to match your style, needs, and vision.
value3Desc: Built on transparency, commitment, and excellence — ensuring a seamless and professional experience from design to delivery.
value4Desc: We follow eco-conscious practices using sustainable materials and optimized production to minimize waste and protect the planet.
calloutHeading: Furnkaar – The Signature Collection by Shilpkaar Furnitures
calloutText: Redefining Indian craftsmanship through design innovation and factory precision. From homes to offices, we deliver furniture that blends elegance, efficiency, and the artistry of true craftsmanship.
machinesSubheading: Explore the cutting-edge technology behind our precision-crafted modular furniture.
m1_desc: Experience flawless precision with our advanced Panel Saw, designed for clean, accurate cuts every time. It ensures smooth edges and perfect alignment, bringing consistency and craftsmanship to every piece of furniture. The result — beautiful finishes that speak of quality and attention to detail.
m2_desc: Our high-performance Beam Saw delivers speed and precision for large-scale panel cutting. Engineered for efficiency, it produces perfectly sized components with minimal waste. This ensures every furniture piece fits seamlessly together, maintaining the highest standards of finish and durability.
m3_desc: For that perfect, seamless look — our Automatic Edge Banding Machine guarantees smooth, durable edges on every panel. It enhances both the strength and elegance of furniture, giving each piece a refined, professional appearance that stands the test of time.
m4_desc: Our Cold Press ensures uniform bonding and flawless surface finishes, essential for premium furniture production. It delivers strength, stability, and a perfectly smooth feel. Each piece that passes through it gains a superior finish that reflects craftsmanship and quality.
m5_desc: Precision meets perfection with our Hinge Boring Machine. Every hinge hole is drilled with exact alignment for smooth fittings and flawless function. This ensures doors open effortlessly and remain durable — enhancing the overall beauty and reliability of the furniture.
m6_desc: Creativity and technology come together in our CNC Router Machine. From intricate patterns to precise cuts, it enables stunning designs with unmatched accuracy. The result — furniture that stands out for its detailed craftsmanship, smooth finish, and distinctive appeal.
m7_desc: Our Three Head Multi Boring Machine boosts efficiency while maintaining absolute precision. It drills multiple holes in perfect alignment, ensuring strong joints and superior build quality. Every product made with it reflects precision engineering and premium finish.
